offer.text: A tool's only as good as the hand that's tested it. Take one of mine to the field and put down four of the undead — I want to know it holds an edge under strain.

accept.text: Use it hard. I'll want the honest truth when you're back.

decline.text: Then it stays on the rack, untried. Pity.

in_progress.text: How's it holding up out there? Four of them, mind.

ready.text: Four down and the edge still true? Then my temper held.

complete.text: Field-proven and battle-tested. That's worth more than any showroom shine. My thanks.
